skill.displayName: Custom Bikini – Design & Try-On Personalized Swimwear Online – CLI-powered
skill.summary: Custom bikini — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of custom-bikini-cli-skill.
- Transform a person’s photo into a bikini model image or video using the WeShop CLI.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports generation of videos (default) or images, batch outputs, and custom prompts.
- Includes security guidelines for API key usage and storage.
